planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno and the buzzer is wired to D6 as tone_output. No other GPIO/PWM/analog/display wiring was provided in the prompt, so no additional program-owned ports are created.

The requirement 'every 2 seconds beep for 200ms' is implemented in SysML using elapsed_ms; tone_output is treated as a single hardware tone channel gated/controlled by model logic (no port inversion/timing embedded here).
No serial behavior is specified; serial_channels is empty.
